module ex-ext {
  yang-version 1.1;
  namespace "urn:example:ex-ext";
  prefix exx;
  import ex-device { prefix exd; }
  import ex-other { prefix exo; }
  description "Augments ex-device; written for the yang2pack tests.";
  augment "/exd:device/exd:port/exd:state" {
    container optics {
      leaf power {
        type decimal64 { fraction-digits 2; }
      }
      leaf lanes { type uint8; }
    }
  }
  augment "/exd:device/exd:power/exd:mains" {
    leaf hertz { type uint8; }
  }
  augment "/exd:device/exo:added" {
    leaf more { type string; }
  }
  augment "/exd:reboot/exd:input" {
    leaf force { type boolean; }
  }
}
